scope: Independent meaning review preparation for the future original-six grammar-constrained translation screen. Candidate outputs and execution directory are not yet available or authorized.
major_error_rule: Any material omission, invention, role reversal, name substitution, quantity/relationship error, or changed condition blocks quality promotion.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material semantic error or notable fluency defect observed in the complete output for this case.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: Recoverable wording or grammar defect without a material change of the tested meaning.
classification_definitions.major_error: The unchanged original major-error rule applies; any such finding blocks quality promotion.

review_policy: Judge complete returned translations for actors, roles, names, quantities, negation, conditions, uncertainty and prose meaning. Lexical indicators flag review only; legitimate localized numbers and consistent name transliterations are permitted. Any unusable, incomplete, limit-stopped or protocol-rejected case remains an execution rejection rather than a successful semantic result. Original source metadata must remain bound.
source_script_names: Exact original-script genuine personal names are considered under the already frozen source-name criteria/design review; they do not exempt ordinary target-language prose, role/actor relationships or any meaning criterion. This does not regrade the rejected Nick/Helen substitutions.
semantic_review_inputs: Complete original source, full actual raw/native translations and exact restored output after completion. Original reference translations remain reviewer-only; none is supplied to the worker.
execution_binding: Pending final root-named execution directory and plan; this record grants no execution authority.
